name: Convika
tagline: Publish AI-made landing pages on your own domain, with a signup form and visitor stats
description: Hosted landing page service. Cline writes the page and saves it to Convika, which returns a private preview link and publishes the page only when you ask, at your-page.convika.com or on your own domain. A page can carry a signup form that keeps every entry, and Cline can read visits, traffic sources, UTM campaigns, button clicks, and signups back to you. Each save is a new version, so a rollback is one call. The server has 37 tools. You can also upload an HTML file or generate a page in the Convika dashboard. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser, with no API key. Free plan: $0, no credit card, 10 pages, 10,000 pageviews a month, 50 form entries a month, and 1 custom domain (a subdomain such as www). Pro is $12 a month.

install.notes: A browser window opens so you can sign in to Convika or create a free account.
